reasons: Claimed status is compliant with no redline and no comment, which is the expected output for a rule whose preferred position is the absence of an obligation.

The cited paragraphs support the conclusion: Section 3.1 sets a flat 30% revenue share above a monthly threshold with no best-terms, price-matching, or 'no less favorable' mechanic burdening the Company (our client, the customer/site owner).

Section 6.1 is correctly characterised as an exclusivity/scope covenant rather than an MFN or third-party-offer-matching obligation, and is expressly deferred to the exclusivity rule, avoiding double-flagging of the same commercial term.

No MFN in the Vendor's favour exists to preserve, and no MFN in our favour is disturbed, so the redline guidance (delete Customer-side obligation) has nothing to act on; leaving the text unchanged is the smallest correct edit.
Deterministic checks are empty and the rendered redline is identical to the original, consistent with a retained-as-evidence compliant finding.
